### Summary of Changes

#### 1. Add `http_connect_error` Hook Handler in `mitmdump`'s Dumper Addon
- **File:** [`mitmproxy/addons/dumper.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/addons/dumper.py#L297-L300)
- **Change:** Implemented [`Dumper.http_connect_error`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/addons/dumper.py#L297-L300) to check `self.match(f)` and call `self.echo_flow(f)`.
- **Why:** In `mitmproxy`, HTTP `CONNECT` requests are instructions to establish an upstream tunnel rather than normal forwarded requests. While successful `CONNECT` handshakes establish tunnels and keep logging focused on inner requests, failed `CONNECT` requests (such as an unreachable upstream server or failed proxy authentication) emit [`HttpConnectErrorHook`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/proxy/layers/http/_hooks.py#L115) (`http_connect_error`) rather than standard `response` or `error` hooks. Because [`Dumper`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/addons/dumper.py#L48) did not implement this hook, `mitmdump` previously omitted output for failed `CONNECT` attempts.

#### 2. Unit Tests
- **File:** [`test/mitmproxy/addons/test_dumper.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/addons/test_dumper.py#L55-L58)
- **Change:** 
  - Added an assertion in `test_simple` verifying that `d.http_connect_error(tflow.tflow(resp=True))` emits output when `flow_detail=1`.
  - Added a dedicated test function `test_http_connect_error` testing that failed `CONNECT` flows (e.g. `CONNECT example.com:443` returning `502 Bad Gateway`) remain suppressed at `flow_detail=0` and are properly formatted in `mitmdump`'s output at `flow_detail=1`.
